title.en: Am Segulah/Am Nivchar — the Chosen People

spans.text:
APPENDIX 4
AM SEGULAH/AM NIVCHAR — 
THE CHOSEN PEOPLE
FAQ: But I do NOT understand the Torah, and to be 
honest, I am NOT happy that I was stuck being part of 
the chosen people! What’s so great about it?
FAQ: Chosen people? Doesn’t this

sound 
racist? I mean, I know a lot of really nice non-Jews — and 
some “not-so-great” Jews! Is there really such a 
difference?
Simply put, the fact that Hashem took us out of Egypt, and three million Jews all heard Him speak at Har Sinai — choosing us as His nation and giving us His Torah and a mission to the world — that is a historical reality! And just like you had no choice as to your complexion, height, or parents, you had no choice whether to be born as part of Klal Yisrael or not. You get what you get — deal with it!Keep in mind that although this mission does come with a lot of responsibility and work, it is a beautiful way of life (full of depth, beauty, and meaning), and the Torah promises great reward. At my stage in life, since I have experienced more than you (and studied more Torah sources), I can see that! But it is possible that for many readers, at this moment there are more parts of Torah that don’t make sense to you than those that do make sense! That does make it hard. And perhaps, unfortunately, your personal experience of Yiddishkeit has not been sweet for all sorts of reasons. That definitely makes it hard. But

and us being Hashem’s special treasure is a reality. (Proving that is not hard at all, but that topic is not for here but for another time and another book. But there are resources out there that cover this topic fully, and a simple look at the miraculous survival of Bnei Yisrael is proof itself!). So if you were born into it, then you need to get with the program, do your best, and hang on until you learn, experience more, and access the sweetness, which I assure you is there!What does it mean to be Hashem’s
, His special treasure? Obviously, it doesn’t mean that we are automatically nicer and better
